title: Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK
summary: Mistral AI released Voxtral 3, a family of 3 transcription models, 1 text-to-speech model and a LiveKit-based voice agent SDK. Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 scores 2.1% AA-WER, ranking #3 on Artificial Analysis. The post Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK appeared first on MarkTechPost .
